top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: From need for speed to seatbelts — AI majors focus on risk aversion
top_signals.summary: For the longest time, artificial intelligence companies competed to make each new model faster and smarter. Ostensibly, there's now a push to exercise restraint.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
